ST. BRIGID'S HOME · PORTLAND, OREGON

22 October 1998

To the adoptee, care of Vale Manor, Bellweather.

At the written request of the late Mr. Arthur Vale, and having confirmed your identity with his executors, we forward the enclosed: one sealed letter and one key, deposited with us in 1994 by your birth mother, to be released to you alone.

A copy of your certificate of adoption (1969) is attached for your records. As is our practice, the child's name at birth has been obscured.

We are sorry it has taken so long.

Sr. M. Agnes, Registrar

CERTIFICATE OF ADOPTION — COPY — STATE OF OREGON — 1969

Child: ████████ (b. Portland, 1968)
Mother: RUTH ORRIN (b. 1946)
Father: not stated
Placed through: St. Brigid's Home
